# CANDIDATE: SKIP_TV_DATA_STALE_QUEUE_AND_RETRY

**Filed:** 2026-07-03
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger_branch
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The SKIP_TV_DATA_STALE heartbeat events are caused by temporary data feed drops, and implementing a queue-and-retry mechanism for TV data loss can reduce the frequency of these events and improve overall system reliability.

## Mechanism

1.  **TV Data Feed Monitor**: Implement a monitor to track the status of the TV data feed, detecting when the feed drops or becomes stale.
2.  **Queue-and-Retry Mechanism**: Design a queue to hold pending requests when the TV data feed is unavailable. When the feed is restored, retry the queued requests to minimize data loss and reduce SKIP_TV_DATA_STALE events.
